Notes

打赢了赔钱

The win/lose construction echoes a widely used police warning: lose a fight and go to hospital; win and go to jail. This lyric uses “pay compensation” for the winning outcome. The next “I’m not afraid” answers the warning with bravado.

  • Yingde Police: the anti-fighting slogan
比耶

比耶 means make the familiar two-finger V gesture used for photographs, victory or “peace.” It is a hand pose rather than merely saying “yeah.” A bright, camera-ready gesture arrives immediately after the warning about fighting, giving the confrontation a deliberately incongruous expression.

  • Genius community transcript
心眼

心眼 can mean shrewdness, suspicion or a calculating intention, as well as the capacity to judge people. 没有心眼 can praise someone’s straightforwardness or expose their naivety. The next lines deliberately provoke and trample others, complicating this claim to live innocently.

  • Genius community transcript
底线

底线 is a bottom line or limit one will not cross, including a moral boundary. Claiming blindness makes “where is the line?” into an excuse for not observing one. The verse then produces actual white lines on a road: the abstract limit leads into the crosswalk image.

  • Genius community transcript
斑马

斑马 means zebra, and 斑马线, “zebra lines,” is the everyday Chinese term for a crosswalk. The sequence paints white stripes on a street, lets them dry, then chants “zebra.” That also brings the artist’s own name into the refrain without having to say “Jack.”

  • Genius community transcript
洗衣机

A washing machine follows the complaint about earning too much money. 洗钱 is the Chinese term for money laundering, literally “wash money”; putting an actual washer beside the money makes that figurative verb into a domestic appliance joke.

  • Genius community transcript
5A级景区

5A is the highest grade in China’s national tourist-attraction rating system. The line adopts development-plan language—“the goal is to build”—then follows it with a formal welcome to auspicious land. The precise grade gives the grand promise the sound of tourism promotion.

  • Ministry of Culture and Tourism: 5A is the highest grade
待接收的转账

The polite 您 and “a transfer waiting to be accepted” read like a payment notification. 举报 then abruptly turns reception into a complaint: the money is only game currency. The short labels 报告, 提醒, 举报 and 遗言 make the verse keep changing its format, from report to alert to accusation to last words.

  • Genius community transcript
